parts.note_add: Catalogue name is 'opener, remote control' 8341-62-315, GS and GSL only, one per car, figure 6230A-1 (S-005 Body-Index p.92, row BI-092-10 by list order). S-001 p.26: two wires, GR from the H-13 dash switch and B to ground X-15, on the 20 A constant fuse shared with the fuel-door release. Owners report the internal rubber bumpers crumble and jam the pinion; the unit unbolts (rod off the latch, two screws in its rubber boot), bends open at its tabs and cleans up; 1981-85 units interchange (rx7club thread). No new or used listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Catalogue name is 'opener, filler lid' FA01-42-480 with its bracket 8871-42-490 (S-005 numeric index, group 4200A-1). S-001 p.26: two wires, GB from the H-15 dash switch and B to ground X-15, 20 A constant fuse shared with the hatch release. Manual release: behind the left rear speaker cover or under the cargo carpet, a slide at the top of the mechanism pushed rearward (or the metal tab on the solenoid) drops the lid; never pry the lid from outside (rx7club thread). No listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

S-001 p.28 drawing: each head is one reversible motor across Lg and LgB and one axis-select solenoid across LgY and B; the LH head's LgY runs straight from the switch through I-02, the RH head's solenoid wire is LgR in the dash harness and becomes LgY at I-04 in the door. Feed WG on the 10 A constant fuse at X-04, ground B via X-02 to X-13. Catalogue: remote-control type 8341-69-110A (R) and 8341-69-170A (L) for GS and GSL, held by four screws 8341-69-178 (S-005 Body-Index p.128). Atkins Rotary stocks no 79-85 side mirrors; used power heads are on Hollander (about 45-50 USD, 2026-09-27).

Catalogue: base (R), mirror 8341-69-131 'use with remote control mirror', GS and GSL, from chassis FB331-503736; the manual-mirror base is a different part, 8871-69-117A (S-005 Body-Index p.128). Sold only with a used mirror; no separate listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Catalogue: base (L), mirror 8341-69-191 'use with remote control mirror', from chassis FB331-503736; the manual-mirror bases are 8871-69-177 (to FB331-507335) and 8871-69-177A (S-005 Body-Index p.129). Sold only with a used mirror; no separate listing found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.93 (fig 6300A-1, item 63-932, qty 1). Seals the glass hatch to the body. New OEM 8871-62-761D at Atkins Rotary (142.78 USD, supersedes 8871-62-761, -761B, -761C) and a Mazdatrix reproduction 8871-62-761D-MZ (53.75 USD), both in stock 2026-09-27.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.93 (fig 6300A-1, item 63-935, qty 1); the moulding around the rear (hatch) window glass. No new or reproduction moulding found online (two searches, 2026-09-27); used only.

Catalogue row 42-410 'lid, fuel filler' 8871-42-410A is for the '81 and '82 models; the '83 lid is a different number, FA54-42-410 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.107). Lift spring FA01-42-431B and two stoppers 0187-70-491 (from FB331-500063) sit with it. No new or used FB lid found online (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.104 (fig 4000A-2 exhaust system, item 58-868C 'plug, service cover'), the plug in the floor over the exhaust tunnel. The same number is still in the Mazda dealer catalogue as a 626 part, so it can be ordered through any Mazda dealer.

Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108 (fig 4300A-1, item 43-041 'rest, foot'). The bare rest is not listed by Atkins Rotary or Mazdatrix; only its pad FA01-43-042 is sold new (two searches, 2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108 (fig 4300A-1, item 43-042 'pad, foot rest', GS and GSL). New Mazda FA01-43-042 at Atkins Rotary, 6.75 USD, in stock 2026-09-27, fits 1981-85.
